title: Eleven Chairs and One Violin
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：concert　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 concert 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my aunt ① gave a concert in a hall that had eleven chairs, and she said the giving was the whole of the practising. The ② concert, meaning the evening and not the music, lasted fifty minutes and stayed that length; concert, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how many stay to the end.

Every ③ concert in that town had the same programme, and the ④ concert at the end, meaning the one she kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about twice. Concert, my mother said, is nine parts programme and one part somebody willing to stay; my aunt said the staying is the part that fills the hall.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the concert was the whole of the argument, meaning the agreement and not the evening. The ⑥ concert, meaning the agreement and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody praises and nobody hears; concert, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both an evening and an agreement. She said the agreement is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ concert had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the programme. The ⑧ concert of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in December, was one hall and thirty years of staying; concert, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stay. He said the staying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ concert I remember is the one at the end, which was given in 1970 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ concert, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being stayed to; every concert, she said, is an agreement that has agreed to look like an evening. She said the agreement was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 音乐会；演奏会
B. n. 音乐会（指那一晚的演出本身，与那些乐曲相对）
C. 固定搭配：give a concert 举办音乐会
D. n. 音乐会（指那个镇上每一场）
E. n. 音乐会（指末尾那一场）
F. n. 一致；协调（in concert，指共同行动的一致）
G. n. 音乐会（指日记里提到的那一场）
H. n. 和谐；合奏（抽象总称）

items.q: gave a concert in a hall that had eleven chairs
The concert, meaning the evening and not the music
the concert was the whole of the argument
the concert had become a line in a diary
The concert of the whole thing
A concert, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: give a concert 意为“举办音乐会”，1956 年姑姑在一间只有十一把椅子的厅里举办了一场音乐会。
concert 意为“音乐会”，指那一晚的演出本身而不是那些乐曲，它持续了五十分钟。
concert 指那个镇上每一场音乐会，每一场都是同样的节目单。
concert 指末尾那一场（她留给冬天的那一场），是唯一有人问过两次的。
concert 意为“一致、协调”，父亲说那种一致就是那场争论的全部，指的是共同行动的一致而不是那一晚的演出。
concert 为另一个义项，指那种一致而不是那一晚的演出，是争论里人人称赞、却无人听见的东西。
concert 意为“音乐会”，指日记里提到的那一场，到 1964 年这场音乐会成了日记里的一行。
concert 意为“和谐、合奏”，姑姑十二月写道，整件事的和谐是一间厅三十年的留下来听。
concert 意为“音乐会”，我记得的是末尾那一场，1970 年举办，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
concert 为抽象总称，母亲说一场音乐会会因为有人听到最后而变好。
